tool_input.content:
import asyncio, json, random, datetime, glob, os, sys
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = "/data/appuser-out/launch-desk/ig-post1"
FILES = sorted(glob.glob(f"{HERE}/slide*.jpg"))
CAPTION = open(f"{HERE}/caption.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
DRY = "--dry" in sys.argv
res = {"at": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat(), "files": len(FILES), "steps": []}

def step(name, **kw):
    res["steps"].append({"step": name, "t": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), **kw})
    json.dump(res, open(f"{OUT}/post_result.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

async def human_wait(pg, a, b):
    await pg.wait_for_timeout(random.randint(a, b))

async def click_text(pg, *names, timeout=15000):
    for n in names:
        for loc in (pg.get_by_role("button", name=n, exact=True), pg.get_by_text(n, exact=True)):
            try:
                await loc.first.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                await loc.first.click()
                return n
            except Exception:
                pass
    return None

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9325")
        ctx = b.contexts[0]
        pg = next((x for x in ctx.pages if "instagram.com" in x.url), None) or await ctx.new_page()
        await pg.bring_to_front()
        await pg.goto("https://www.instagram.com/", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
        await human_wait(pg, 6000, 10000)
        for _ in range(random.randint(2, 4)):
            await pg.mouse.wheel(0, random.randint(300, 900)); await human_wait(pg, 2500, 6000)
        await pg.mouse.wheel(0, -3000); await human_wait(pg, 2000, 4000)
        await pg.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/p1_home.png")
        step("home", url=pg.url)

        create = pg.locator("svg[aria-label='New post'], svg[aria-label='Create']").first
        try:
            await create.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=15000); await create.click()
        except Exception:
            if not await click_text(pg, "Create", "New post"):
                step("no_create_button"); await pg.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/p_fail.png"); return
        await human_wait(pg, 1500, 3000)
        sub = await click_text(pg, "Post", timeout=4000)
        step("create_opened", submenu=sub)
        await human_wait(pg, 2000, 3500)

        inp = pg.locator("div[role='dialog'] input[type='file'], form input[type='file']").first
        await inp.wait_for(state="attached", timeout=20000)
        await inp.set_input_files(FILES)
        await human_wait(pg, 6000, 9000)
        await pg.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/p2_selected.png")
        step("files_set")

        for i in range(2):
            n = await click_text(pg, "Next", timeout=20000)
            step(f"next_{i+1}", ok=bool(n)); await human_wait(pg, 3000, 5500)
            if not n:
                await pg.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/p_fail.png"); return

        cap = pg.locator("div[aria-label='Write a caption...'][contenteditable='true'], div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']").first
        await cap.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=20000)
        await cap.click(); await human_wait(pg, 800, 1500)
        for li, line in enumerate(CAPTION.split("\n")):
            if li:
                await pg.keyboard.press("Shift+Enter"); await human_wait(pg, 300, 800)
            for ch in line:
                await pg.keyboard.type(ch, delay=random.randint(45, 140))
                if random.random() < 0.04: await human_wait(pg, 300, 1100)
        await human_wait(pg, 2500, 4500)
        await pg.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/p3_caption.png")
        step("caption_typed")
        if DRY:
            step("dry_stop"); return

        n = await click_text(pg, "Share", timeout=15000)
        step("share_clicked", ok=bool(n))
        ok = False
        for _ in range(36):
            await pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
            txt = await pg.evaluate("()=>document.body.innerText")
            if "has been shared" in txt or "Post shared" in txt:
                ok = True; break
        await pg.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/p4_after.png")
        step("shared", ok=ok)
        await human_wait(pg, 3000, 6000)
        await pg.keyboard.press("Escape")

os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
try:
    asyncio.run(main())
except Exception as e:
    step("error", error=repr(e)[:400])
step("end")
